D: A Kree warrior crashes into 1990s Earth and starts piecing together who she really is.
P: Serve the snacks when Carol crashes through the roof of the video store.
S: Video store brown butter parmesan popcorn
Popcorn tossed with nutty brown butter and parmesan salt

Fresh popcorn tossed in nutty brown butter, finely grated parmesan and rosemary salt, piled into big tubs like the rental counter. Heat 3 tbsp oil and 120g popcorn kernels in a big lidded pot over medium-high heat, shaking until the popping slows. Melt 80g butter in a small pan and cook until it smells nutty and turns golden brown. Blitz 1 tsp sea salt with 1 tsp rosemary leaves. Toss the popcorn with the brown butter, 40g finely grated parmesan and the rosemary salt. Serve in big tubs.
Panko crusted salmon pieces baked golden, with tartar sauce to dip
Salmon cut into bite-sized pieces, dusted in flour, dipped in egg and panko, baked at 220C for 12 minutes until golden, with tartare sauce to dip.

Sweet crab meat bound with mayo, mustard, spring onion and breadcrumbs, pan-fried crisp and golden, with a tangy caper remoulade. Mix 400g drained crab meat with 3 tbsp mayo, 1 tsp Dijon mustard, 2 sliced spring onions, 1 egg, 60g panko and a pinch of cayenne. Shape into 8 small cakes and chill 30 minutes. Fry in oil and butter over medium heat for 3 minutes a side until golden. For the remoulade, mix 100g mayo with 1 tbsp chopped capers, 1 tbsp chopped pickles, 1 tsp mustard, paprika and lemon juice.
M: Dark roux gumbo with chicken, smoked sausage and okra, served over rice
Chicken and smoked sausage simmered in a dark roux with okra, capsicum, onion and celery, over rice.
W: Tart lemon filling in a sweet crust under glossy meringue
Sweet pastry blind baked, filled with a lemon curd of juice, zest, sugar, cornflour, yolks and butter, topped with meringue and browned at 200C for 6 minutes.
K: Frozen peach and orange slush with peach schnapps, or a no-alcohol swap

A nineties party classic blitzed into a slushie: peach schnapps, orange juice and frozen peaches, with a cherry on top. Blend 300g frozen peach slices, 500ml orange juice, 160ml peach schnapps, the juice of 1 lime and 2 cups of ice until thick and slushy. Pour into 4 chilled glasses and top each with a maraschino cherry and an orange wheel. For a booze-free version, leave out the schnapps and add 150ml peach nectar.

m.note: Dark roux gumbo with chicken, smoked sausage and okra, served over rice
m.how: Cook 60g flour in 60ml oil, stirring for 20 minutes until dark brown. Add diced onion, green capsicum and celery and soften. Add 600g chicken thighs, 300g sliced smoked sausage, okra and 1.5L water. Simmer an hour and serve over long grain rice.

w.note: Tart lemon filling in a sweet crust under glossy meringue
w.how: Blind bake a sweet shortcrust case. Whisk the juice and zest of 4 lemons, 200g sugar, 4 tbsp cornflour, 4 yolks and 60g butter over heat until thick, then pour into the case. Whisk the 4 whites with 150g sugar to glossy peaks, pile on top and bake at 200C for 6 minutes.
